capabilities: Insert Lonelog notation symbols via command palette commands and custom hotkeys
Generate campaign, session, and scene structure with automatic headers and numbering
Highlight and colorize Lonelog tokens in Live Preview and Reading mode
Track combat, dungeon rooms, resources, and card draws through add-on views
Write group-session notes in partylog code blocks and browse a Partylog dashboard
disambiguation: Not a generic journaling or daily-notes tool; it implements the Lonelog notation standard specifically for TTRPG session logs.
extras: Documentation is split across separate files (lonelog-api.md, Spanish README, API changelog); the plugin exposes a public API v1 for other plugins and offers English and Spanish localization; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: bringing the Lonelog notation standard into your vault and extending it with the Partylog add-on
problem: Obsidian has no built-in notation or tooling for structured solo or group TTRPG session journaling, so players log actions, oracle questions, dice rolls, and entities by hand.

relations.evidence: bringing the Lonelog notation standard into your vault and extending it with the Partylog add-on

summary: TTRPG journaling plugin that brings the Lonelog notation standard to Obsidian, with syntax highlighting, add-on trackers, and a Partylog group-session dashboard.
